Eating habits of sea cucumber ( Holothuria scabra ) and sea cucumber sap ( Holothuria vagabunda ) in Karas waters, Batam City, Indonesia %K Sea cucumber; Type of food; Eating habit; Batam city %X The aim of this study was to find out the types of food eaten by sea cucumber sand ( H. scabra ) and sea cucumber ( H. vagabunda ), to know the habits of eating sea cucumber ( H. scabra ) and sea cucumber ( H. vagabunda ) in Karas waters, Galang District, Batam City. Determination of sampling points using results of the study found 3 types of sea cucumber food namely percentage, Bacillariophyceae 49,82%, Sarcodina 2,23%, Crustacea 24,33%, and 5 types of food Sea Cucumber Seafish with percentage, Bacillariophyceae 50,75%, Sarcodina 3,91%, Crustacea 4,83%, Copepoda 0,52%, and Seagrass Fiber 0,30%. %U https://journals.sangia.org/ISLE/article/view/293 %0 Journal Article %R 10.29239/j.akuatikisle.4.1.13-19 %& 13 %P 7 %J Akuatikisle: Jurnal Akuakultur, Pesisir dan Pulau-Pulau Kecil %V 4 %N 1 %@ 2598-8298 %8 2020-05-31 %7 2020-05-31
